description: Golden bodies of the service levels and alerts (E11, #13250; the feature is #13297): GET /api/playtest/service-health, the service-watch job's result, the alerts the job hands verse.service_sync, and the route's refusals. Each body is what coax/web/api/service.c wrote with its own snprintf before coax/web/api/service-wire.coax, byte for byte: the members C wrote are compact, and what PostgreSQL built (daily, alerts, resolved_day, sync) is jsonb's text, with a space after each colon and comma. values are the writer's arguments; a raw JSON argument is a string here. coax/web/api/service-wire-goldens.coax writes each through the codec, holds its keys to the descriptor, reads it back and writes it again; coax/web/api/test_jobs.py does the same for a running API's bodies.
